hack.category: Lending / Money Market (Compound fork via Ola Finance)
hack.root_cause: ERC677 callAfterTransfer() reentrancy in Compound fork — borrow before balance update
hack.description: Voltage Finance lost $4M to the exact same ERC677 reentrancy that had hit two other Compound forks on Gnosis chain weeks earlier — the attack looped through BUSD, USDC, FUSD, WBTC, WETH, and FUSE by withdrawing both borrow proceeds and collateral tokens before the protocol registered the debt.
